title: Credit Card Due Reminder - Automated Notification System
description: Validate the automated credit card due reminder notification system sends timely alerts with proper security masking
testDescription: Verify that the system automatically generates and sends due reminder notifications to cardholders before payment due date with last 4 digits displayed
prerequisites: Active credit card account with upcoming payment due date, notification system operational, customer contact information valid
stepsToPerform: 1. Set up credit card account with payment due date 7 days from current date, 2. Configure automated notification trigger for 3 days before due date, 3. Verify cardholder contact preferences (email, SMS, postal), 4. Execute automated notification job, 5. Capture generated notification content, 6. Verify last 4 digits of credit card are displayed (****1234), 7. Confirm full credit card number is not exposed anywhere, 8. Validate payment amount and due date accuracy, 9. Check notification delivery across all configured channels, 10. Verify notification timing meets regulatory requirements
expectedResult: Due reminder notification sent successfully with last 4 digits displayed, full card number masked, accurate payment details, and delivered through selected channels

title: Overdue Balance Alert - Payment Missed Escalation
description: Validate overdue balance alert processing when cardholder misses payment due date
testDescription: Verify that system automatically triggers overdue balance alerts when payment due date passes without payment reception
prerequisites: Credit card account with missed payment due date, overdue balance calculation system active, escalation triggers configured
stepsToPerform: 1. Set up credit card account with payment due date 1 day ago, 2. Confirm no payment received by system cutoff time, 3. Execute overdue balance alert trigger process, 4. Verify overdue balance calculation includes principal, interest, and late fees, 5. Generate alert notification content, 6. Validate last 4 digits display (****5678) in alert, 7. Confirm full credit card number remains masked, 8. Check consequence warnings included in alert content, 9. Verify alert delivery to all registered communication channels, 10. Update account status to overdue in system
expectedResult: Overdue balance alert triggered automatically, accurate balance calculation with fees, last 4 digits displayed, consequences clearly stated, and account status updated

title: Collection Notification - Formal Delinquency Process
description: Validate formal collection notification generation when account becomes significantly delinquent
testDescription: Verify that system generates formal collection notifications for significantly delinquent accounts with proper calculations and legal compliance
prerequisites: Credit card account 60 days past due, delinquency threshold calculations active, collection notification templates configured
stepsToPerform: 1. Set up credit card account 60 days past due with accumulated charges, 2. Execute delinquency threshold evaluation process, 3. Trigger formal collection notification generation, 4. Calculate total amount owed including principal, interest, late fees, and collection charges, 5. Generate formal collection notice content, 6. Verify last 4 digits of credit card displayed (****9012), 7. Ensure full credit card number is completely masked, 8. Validate all charges are itemized and calculated correctly, 9. Check legal compliance statements included in notification, 10. Confirm delivery via certified mail and electronic channels
expectedResult: Formal collection notification generated with accurate calculations, itemized charges, last 4 digits displayed, legal compliance statements, and delivered via appropriate channels

title: Payment Plan Proposal - Structured Repayment Option
description: Validate payment plan proposal system for cardholders unable to pay full overdue balance
testDescription: Verify that system generates appropriate payment plan proposals with reduced interest rates and structured repayment schedules
prerequisites: Delinquent credit card account eligible for payment plan, payment plan calculation engine active, customer financial assessment completed
stepsToPerform: 1. Set up delinquent credit card account with $2000 overdue balance, 2. Perform payment plan eligibility assessment based on account history, 3. Calculate structured repayment options with reduced interest rates, 4. Generate payment plan proposal document, 5. Verify last 4 digits of credit card included (****3456), 6. Confirm full credit card number is masked throughout proposal, 7. Validate payment schedule calculations for 6, 12, and 18-month options, 8. Check reduced interest rate applications (from 24.99% to 12.99%), 9. Verify fee reduction calculations and waivers, 10. Confirm proposal delivery and acceptance mechanism setup
expectedResult: Payment plan proposal generated with multiple repayment options, reduced interest rates, accurate calculations, last 4 digits displayed, and acceptance mechanism functional

title: Legal Action Initiation - Court Proceedings Preparation
description: Validate legal action initiation process for extreme cases of non-payment with proper documentation
testDescription: Verify that system initiates legal action procedures with accurate documentation and compliance requirements for court proceedings
prerequisites: Credit card account 120+ days delinquent with failed collection attempts, legal action eligibility confirmed, court documentation system operational
stepsToPerform: 1. Set up credit card account 150 days past due with documented collection attempts, 2. Verify all previous collection stages have been completed per regulatory requirements, 3. Execute legal action eligibility assessment, 4. Generate legal documentation package for court filing, 5. Verify last 4 digits of credit card included in all legal documents (****7890), 6. Confirm full credit card number is never exposed in legal documentation, 7. Validate complete payment history and collection attempt timeline, 8. Check calculation accuracy for principal, interest, fees, and legal costs, 9. Verify compliance with state-specific legal requirements, 10. Confirm proper service of legal notice procedures initiated
expectedResult: Legal action documentation generated accurately with complete payment history, proper calculations, last 4 digits displayed, full compliance with legal requirements, and service procedures initiated
regulatoryRequirement: State Legal Action Requirements, FDCPA Compliance

title: Collection Agency Integration - Data Transfer and Handoff Process
description: Validate the complete workflow for transferring delinquent accounts to collection agencies with secure data transmission and proper account assignment logic
testDescription: Verify that system successfully transfers account data to collection agencies when internal collection efforts fail, ensuring secure PII transmission and proper agency assignment
prerequisites: Credit card account 90 days past due with failed internal collection attempts, collection agency integration system active, data encryption protocols operational, agency capacity management system configured
stepsToPerform: 1. Set up credit card account 90 days past due with documented failed collection attempts, 2. Execute collection agency eligibility assessment based on balance amount and geographic location, 3. Select appropriate collection agency using assignment logic algorithm, 4. Prepare secure data package with account details and collection history, 5. Verify last 4 digits of credit card included in transfer data (****4567), 6. Confirm full credit card number is encrypted and never transmitted in plain text, 7. Execute secure data transmission to assigned collection agency, 8. Update internal account status to 'External Collection', 9. Generate handoff confirmation and audit trail, 10. Verify collection agency acknowledgment receipt and data integrity validation
expectedResult: Account successfully transferred to collection agency with secure data transmission, last 4 digits properly displayed, full card number encrypted, account status updated, and complete audit trail generated

title: Multi-Channel Communication Workflow - Cross-Platform Notification Delivery
description: Validate comprehensive multi-channel communication system delivering collection notifications across email, SMS, postal mail, and phone channels with consistent messaging and security
testDescription: Verify that collection notifications are delivered consistently across all communication channels with proper content personalization, security masking, and delivery confirmation tracking
prerequisites: Credit card account in collection stage, multi-channel communication system operational, customer contact preferences configured, delivery tracking system active
stepsToPerform: 1. Set up credit card account 45 days past due with multi-channel communication preferences, 2. Generate collection notification content for multiple delivery channels, 3. Personalize notification content based on customer profile and account status, 4. Verify last 4 digits of credit card displayed consistently across all channels (****8901), 5. Confirm full credit card number is masked in all communication formats, 6. Execute simultaneous delivery across email, SMS, postal mail, and automated phone systems, 7. Track delivery confirmation for each communication channel, 8. Monitor customer response across all channels, 9. Update communication history and preference tracking, 10. Verify compliance with communication frequency regulations
expectedResult: Collection notifications delivered successfully across all channels with consistent messaging, proper security masking, delivery confirmations received, and communication history updated
deliveryConfirmation: Email Opened, SMS Delivered, Mail Tracking Active, Call Completed

title: Payment Plan Execution - End-to-End Repayment Processing
description: Validate complete payment plan execution workflow from customer acceptance through automated payment processing and plan completion
testDescription: Verify that accepted payment plans are executed properly with automated payment processing, interest calculations, and plan status tracking through completion
prerequisites: Approved payment plan proposal with customer acceptance, automated payment processing system active, interest calculation engine operational, plan tracking system configured
stepsToPerform: 1. Set up accepted 12-month payment plan for $2400 balance with $220 monthly payments, 2. Configure automated payment processing schedule for monthly deductions, 3. Execute first scheduled payment and verify processing accuracy, 4. Calculate and apply reduced interest rate (15.99%) to remaining balance, 5. Update account status to 'Payment Plan Active', 6. Verify last 4 digits display in payment confirmations (****2345), 7. Ensure full credit card number remains protected during all payment transactions, 8. Process subsequent monthly payments and track plan progression, 9. Generate monthly payment plan statements with progress tracking, 10. Complete final payment and update account status to 'Plan Completed'
expectedResult: Payment plan executed successfully with accurate automated payments, proper interest calculations, secure card number handling, progress tracking, and final completion status update

title: Account Status Transition Management - Lifecycle State Changes
description: Validate comprehensive account status transition management throughout the complete collection lifecycle with proper state validation and audit logging
testDescription: Verify that account status transitions occur correctly through all collection lifecycle stages with proper validation, business rule enforcement, and complete audit trail generation
prerequisites: Credit card account with transition capability through all collection stages, state management system operational, business rule engine active, audit logging system configured
stepsToPerform: 1. Initialize credit card account in 'Current' status with upcoming due date, 2. Execute status transition to 'Past Due' when payment deadline passes, 3. Validate business rules for 30-day transition to 'Delinquent' status, 4. Process transition to 'Serious Delinquency' at 60-day mark with proper escalation triggers, 5. Execute transition to 'Collection' status at 90 days with agency assignment, 6. Verify last 4 digits consistency across all status change notifications (****5432), 7. Confirm full credit card number protection throughout all transitions, 8. Process transition to 'Payment Plan' status when customer accepts repayment proposal, 9. Generate comprehensive audit trail for all status changes with timestamps and reasons, 10. Validate final transition to 'Charged Off' or 'Resolved' based on collection outcome
expectedResult: Account status transitions executed correctly through all lifecycle stages with proper validation, business rule enforcement, secure card number handling, and complete audit trail documentation
statusHistory: Current > Past Due > Delinquent > Serious Delinquency > Collection > Payment Plan
transitionTriggers: Payment Due Date, 30-Day Rule, 60-Day Rule, 90-Day Rule, Customer Acceptance
auditTrail: Complete with Timestamps, User Actions, System Triggers

title: Regulatory Compliance Validation - FDCPA and State Law Adherence
description: Validate comprehensive regulatory compliance across all collection activities ensuring adherence to FDCPA requirements and state-specific consumer protection laws
testDescription: Verify that all collection processes comply with federal FDCPA requirements and applicable state laws including communication restrictions, validation notices, and consumer rights protection
prerequisites: Collection system with regulatory compliance modules active, FDCPA validation engine operational, state law database current, compliance monitoring system configured
stepsToPerform: 1. Set up collection scenario triggering multiple regulatory compliance checkpoints, 2. Execute initial collection notice generation with mandatory FDCPA validation notice, 3. Verify 30-day validation period compliance and dispute process availability, 4. Validate communication frequency restrictions and time-of-day limitations, 5. Check proper disclosure statements in all collection communications, 6. Verify last 4 digits usage complies with PII protection regulations (****6789), 7. Confirm full credit card number never appears in violation of security regulations, 8. Execute state-specific law compliance checks for customer jurisdiction, 9. Validate cease and desist functionality when customer requests communication stop, 10. Generate comprehensive compliance report documenting all regulatory adherence points
expectedResult: All collection activities demonstrate full regulatory compliance with FDCPA requirements and state laws, proper PII handling, validation notices provided, and comprehensive compliance documentation generated
regulatoryRequirement: FDCPA Section 809 Validation Notice, State Consumer Protection Laws
communicationRestrictions: No calls before 8 AM or after 9 PM, No more than 3 attempts per week
customerRights: Dispute Process, Validation Request, Cease Communication Request
complianceStatus: Fully Compliant with Federal and State Requirements

title: Collection Agency Data Synchronization - Real-time Updates and Response Processing
description: Validate real-time data synchronization between internal systems and collection agencies including payment updates, customer communications, and status changes
testDescription: Verify that data synchronization occurs correctly between internal collection systems and external collection agencies with real-time updates and bi-directional communication
prerequisites: Credit card account assigned to collection agency, real-time data sync system operational, API integration active, payment processing system connected
stepsToPerform: 1. Set up credit card account actively managed by collection agency with ongoing activities, 2. Process customer payment received directly by collection agency, 3. Verify real-time payment update synchronization to internal systems, 4. Execute customer communication logged by collection agency, 5. Validate communication history sync with internal records, 6. Process payment plan modification requested by customer through agency, 7. Verify last 4 digits consistency in all synchronized data (****3210), 8. Confirm full credit card number remains encrypted during all data transfers, 9. Execute account status change initiated by collection agency, 10. Validate complete audit trail synchronization across both systems
expectedResult: Data synchronization completed successfully with real-time updates, accurate payment processing, communication history maintained, last 4 digits properly displayed, and complete audit trail synchronized

title: Payment Timing Edge Case - Mid-Collection Payment Processing
description: Validate payment processing scenarios where customer payments are received during active collection escalation processes
testDescription: Verify that customer payments received during collection escalation are processed correctly with proper workflow interruption and status adjustments
prerequisites: Credit card account in active collection escalation, payment processing system operational, workflow management system active, status update engine configured
stepsToPerform: 1. Set up credit card account 75 days past due with scheduled legal action preparation, 2. Initiate legal action documentation generation process, 3. Process customer payment received during legal action preparation, 4. Verify immediate payment application to outstanding balance, 5. Execute collection workflow interruption and status reassessment, 6. Calculate remaining balance after payment application, 7. Verify last 4 digits display in payment confirmation (****9876), 8. Confirm full credit card number protection during payment processing, 9. Update collection stage based on new account status and remaining balance, 10. Generate updated collection strategy based on payment and remaining balance
expectedResult: Payment processed successfully during collection escalation, workflow adjusted appropriately, balance updated accurately, last 4 digits displayed in confirmations, and collection strategy updated based on new status

title: Communication Template Management - Dynamic Content Generation
description: Validate dynamic communication template management system with personalized content generation based on account status, customer profile, and collection stage
testDescription: Verify that communication templates are dynamically generated with personalized content based on customer data, account status, and regulatory requirements
prerequisites: Communication template system operational, customer profile database active, personalization engine configured, regulatory template library updated
stepsToPerform: 1. Set up credit card account with comprehensive customer profile and collection history, 2. Execute template selection algorithm based on account status and collection stage, 3. Generate personalized notification content using customer data variables, 4. Apply regulatory-specific language based on customer state jurisdiction, 5. Insert last 4 digits of credit card using secure template variables (****1357), 6. Verify full credit card number is never accessible to template system, 7. Execute A/B testing for template effectiveness across customer segments, 8. Generate multi-language templates based on customer language preferences, 9. Validate template compliance with accessibility requirements, 10. Process template delivery optimization based on customer response history
expectedResult: Communication templates generated successfully with personalized content, regulatory compliance, proper security masking, accessibility compliance, and optimized delivery based on customer preferences

title: Interest Rate and Fee Calculation Engine - Complex Financial Computations
description: Validate comprehensive interest rate and fee calculation engine for various collection scenarios including compound interest, penalty fees, and payment plan adjustments
testDescription: Verify that interest rates and fees are calculated accurately across all collection scenarios with proper compound interest application, penalty assessments, and payment plan modifications
prerequisites: Financial calculation engine operational, interest rate database current, fee structure configuration active, payment plan calculation module configured
stepsToPerform: 1. Set up credit card account with complex fee structure and varying interest rates, 2. Execute compound interest calculation for 90-day delinquency period, 3. Apply penalty fees based on collection stage escalation triggers, 4. Calculate payment plan interest rate reductions and fee waivers, 5. Process partial payment allocation between principal, interest, and fees, 6. Verify calculation accuracy against financial regulations and business rules, 7. Generate detailed fee breakdown with last 4 digits identification (****2468), 8. Confirm full credit card number never appears in calculation outputs, 9. Execute boundary testing with maximum and minimum calculation values, 10. Validate calculation audit trail with complete mathematical verification
expectedResult: Interest rates and fees calculated accurately with proper compound interest, penalty assessments, payment plan adjustments, detailed breakdowns, and complete mathematical audit trail

testDescription: Verify that complete collection ecosystem operates seamlessly across all integrated systems with proper data flow, status synchronization, and process coordination
prerequisites: All collection system integrations active, notification system operational, payment processing connected, collection agency APIs functional, legal system integration configured, customer portal active
stepsToPerform: 1. Initialize credit card account requiring complete collection lifecycle processing across all systems, 2. Execute automated notification generation and delivery coordination, 3. Process payment attempts through integrated payment systems, 4. Coordinate collection agency assignment and data transfer protocols, 5. Integrate legal system preparation for potential court proceedings, 6. Synchronize customer portal with real-time account status and payment options, 7. Verify last 4 digits consistency across all integrated systems (****8024), 8. Confirm full credit card number security maintained throughout all system integrations, 9. Execute end-to-end transaction tracing across complete system ecosystem, 10. Validate complete data integrity and audit trail across all integrated platforms
expectedResult: Cross-system integration completed successfully with seamless data flow, synchronized status updates, coordinated processes, consistent security masking, and complete end-to-end traceability
integratedSystems: Notifications, Payments, Collection Agency, Legal, Customer Portal
integrationCompliance: SOX, PCI DSS, FDCPA Cross-System Requirements
